description: Classement fonctionnel des routes nationales de La Réunion is a dataset listed in Portail Open Data de La Réunion, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Conseil Régional de La Réunion. La classement fonctionnel des routes nationales de La Réunion Données extraites du Système d'Information Routier de la Région Réunion, Direction de l'Exploitation et de l'Entretien des Routes Dernière mise à jour: novembre 2024. Coverage: La Réunion. The portal files it under Transports et déplacements. Its keywords are route, rn, circulation, reseau, sig, sir. The portal shows 28 records. The portal flags it as a time series. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2024-11-29 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte (Etalab) (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/wp-content/uploads/2014/05/Licence_Ouverte.pdf). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-regionreunion-com-portal.
